pages.title: Aggregate Calculator Pakistan {season_year} – All Universities
pages.description: Free aggregate calculator for MDCAT, UET, NUST, COMSATS, FAST and PU. Get your aggregate, then see last year's closing merit and where you can get in.
pages.content:
Calculate your aggregate, see where last year's closing merit says you can get in, and open the full merit list for MDCAT, UET, NUST, COMSATS, FAST, PU and more.

Start with MDCAT

  • MDCAT aggregate calculator: the PMDC formula (50% MDCAT, 40% FSc, 10% Matric) with last year's MBBS and BDS closing merits.
  • MDCAT merit list {season_year}: MBBS and BDS closing merit {data_year} for every UHS Punjab public and private college.
  • How to calculate MDCAT aggregate and what closing merit means.

Engineering and computing

  • UET Taxila aggregate calculator (33% ECAT, 50% FSc Part-I, 17% Matric) and the UET Taxila merit list with official closing merits.
  • UET Peshawar aggregate calculator (50% entrance test, 40% FSc Part-I, 10% Matric).
  • NED aggregate calculator (60% NED test, 40% HSC Part-I).
  • FAST aggregate calculator for computing and engineering programs.
  • GIKI aggregate calculator (85% test, 15% Matric).
  • 1st vs 2nd vs final merit list: how much merit drops between lists.

UET Lahore, NUST, COMSATS and general universities are being added next. Every number links to its official source; see how we collect them in our methodology.

pages.title: MDCAT Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (PMDC Formula)
pages.description: Free MDCAT aggregate calculator {season_year} with the PMDC formula: 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc, 10% Matric. See your aggregate and last year's MBBS closing merit.
pages.subtitle: PMDC formula: 50% MDCAT + 40% FSc + 10% Matric
pages.answer: The MDCAT aggregate for {season_year} = 50% MDCAT + 40% FSc (pre-medical) + 10% Matric, as fixed by PMDC's admission regulations. Divide each score by its total, multiply by its weight and add: 150/180 MDCAT, 1000/1100 FSc and 1000/1100 Matric give 87.12%. Enter your marks below to get yours.

faq.q: What is the MDCAT aggregate formula for {season_year}?
faq.a: PMDC's 2026 admission regulations set the aggregate as 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc (pre-medical) or equivalent and 10% Matric or equivalent. The 2025 regulations used the same weights.

faq.q: Is the MDCAT aggregate formula the same for MBBS and BDS?
faq.a: Yes. The same 50/40/10 formula is used for MBBS and BDS; only the closing merits differ, because each college and program fills its seats separately.

faq.q: How many marks is MDCAT out of?
faq.a: MDCAT 2025 had 180 multiple-choice questions with no negative marking, according to PMDC. If your result shows a different total, change the MDCAT total in the calculator.

faq.q: What aggregate is needed for a public MBBS college in Punjab?
faq.a: In the final 2025 UHS list, public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% (Narowal Medical College) and 94.87% (King Edward Medical University) on open merit.

faq.q: How much MDCAT score is needed for MBBS with 1050 in FSc and Matric?
faq.a: With 1050/1100 in both, FSc and Matric give 47.73 points. You would need about 165/180 in MDCAT to reach 93.51%, the lowest public MBBS closing merit in Punjab in 2025.

faq.q: My FSc result is out of 1200. What should I enter?
faq.a: Enter your marks and change the FSc total to 1200. The calculator converts marks to a percentage of whatever total you enter.

faq.q: MDCAT aggregate kaise nikalain?
faq.a: MDCAT marks ko total se divide kar ke 50 se multiply karein, FSc marks ko total se divide kar ke 40 se, aur Matric marks ko total se divide kar ke 10 se. Teeno ko jama karein, yehi aap ka aggregate hai.

faq.q: Kitna aggregate ho to government medical college mil jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka open merit 93.51% se 94.87% ke darmiyan close hua. Har saal yeh thora upar neeche hota hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
MDCAT aggregate ka formula PMDC ne fix kiya hai: MDCAT ka 50%, FSc ka 40% aur Matric ka 10%. Apne marks upar calculator mein daalein, aggregate foran aa jaye ga.

Misaal: MDCAT 150/180, FSc 1000/1100 aur Matric 1000/1100 ho to aggregate 87.12% banta hai. 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges 93.51% se 94.87% par close hue, is liye apna aggregate MDCAT merit list se zaroor milayein.

pages.h1: MDCAT Merit List {season_year} & MBBS/BDS Closing Merit {data_year}
pages.subtitle: Punjab public and private medical and dental colleges (UHS), open merit
pages.answer: In the final {data_year} UHS selection list, Punjab public MBBS colleges closed between 94.87% (King Edward Medical University) and 93.51% (Narowal Medical College) on open merit, about 0.7 to 1.2 points lower than in 2024. Private MBBS colleges closed between 90.84% and 61.00%, and public BDS colleges at about 93.4%.

faq.q: What was the MBBS closing merit in {data_year} in Punjab?
faq.a: In the 13th and final UHS list for {data_year}, public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% and 94.87% on open merit. King Edward Medical University was highest and Narowal Medical College lowest.

faq.q: What was the KEMU closing merit in {data_year}?
faq.a: King Edward Medical University, Lahore closed at 94.87% on open merit in the final {data_year} list (94.92% in the 1st list), down from 96.06% in the last 2024 list.

faq.q: What is the lowest merit for private MBBS in Punjab?
faq.a: In the 5th and final {data_year} UHS private MBBS list, the lowest open-merit closing aggregate was 61.00% (Queens Medical College, Kasur, for women only). Most private colleges closed well above that; check each college in the table.

faq.q: What was the BDS closing merit in {data_year}?
faq.a: Public BDS colleges in Punjab closed between 93.42% and 93.46% in the 13th {data_year} list. Private BDS colleges closed between 73.13% and 55.87% in the 3rd list.

faq.q: Why is the 1st merit list higher than the final list?
faq.a: Students who get a seat in the 1st list move to colleges they prefer or leave, and their seats go to the next students in merit. So the last admitted aggregate usually falls with each list.

faq.q: Where is the official UHS merit list?
faq.a: UHS publishes college-wise selection lists on uhs.edu.pk. Every row in our table links to the exact official list the figure came from.

faq.q: Pichle saal MBBS ka merit kitna tha?
faq.a: 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka final open merit 93.51% se 94.87% tha. KEMU sab se upar 94.87% par aur Narowal Medical College sab se neeche 93.51% par close hua.

faq.q: Private medical college ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 ki final list mein private MBBS colleges 90.84% se 61.00% tak close hue. Har college ka alag merit hai, table mein apna college dekhein.

pages.roman_urdu:
Yeh UHS Punjab ki official selection lists se liya gaya closing merit hai, yani har college mein open merit par aakhri admission kis aggregate par hua.

2025 ki final list mein government MBBS colleges 93.51% se 94.87% par close hue, jo 2024 se taqreeban 0.7 se 1.2 points kam hai. Apna aggregate MDCAT aggregate calculator se nikalein aur table se milayein.

pages.title: How to Calculate MDCAT Aggregate ({season_year} Formula)
pages.description: How to calculate MDCAT aggregate in {season_year}: the PMDC formula (50% MDCAT, 40% FSc, 10% Matric), a worked example, what each mark is worth and common mistakes.
pages.h1: How to Calculate MDCAT Aggregate in {season_year}
pages.answer: To calculate your MDCAT aggregate, take 50% of your MDCAT percentage, 40% of your FSc percentage and 10% of your Matric percentage, then add them. PMDC's 2026 admission regulations fix these weights. Example: MDCAT 160/180, FSc 1020/1100 and Matric 1050/1100 give 44.44 + 37.09 + 9.55 = 91.08%.

faq.q: Who decides the MDCAT aggregate formula?
faq.a: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PMDC) sets it in its admission regulations. Admitting universities such as UHS apply it when making merit lists.

faq.q: Has the MDCAT formula changed for {season_year}?
faq.a: No. The 2026 regulations keep the same weights as 2025: 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc and 10% Matric.

faq.q: How many aggregate points is one MDCAT mark worth?
faq.a: With MDCAT out of 180, one mark is worth about 0.28 aggregate points (50 divided by 180).

faq.q: Can I use FSc Part-I marks?
faq.a: Use marks and a total that match. If you only have Part-I marks, enter them with the Part-I total; the admitting university's notice says which marks it accepts.

faq.q: MDCAT aggregate ka formula kya hai?
faq.a: MDCAT 50%, FSc 40% aur Matric 10%. Har subject ke marks ko total se divide karein, weight se multiply karein aur jama kar lein.

faq.q: Aik MDCAT mark se aggregate kitna barhta hai?
faq.a: 180 marks ke paper mein aik mark se taqreeban 0.28 aggregate barhta hai, is liye MDCAT ke 10 marks taqreeban 2.8 points ka farq daalte hain.

pages.roman_urdu:
PMDC ka formula seedha hai: MDCAT ka 50%, FSc ka 40%, Matric ka 10%. Misaal: MDCAT 160/180, FSc 1020/1100, Matric 1050/1100 ho to aggregate 91.08% banta hai.

Khud hisaab nahi lagana to MDCAT aggregate calculator istemal karein.

pages.title: What Is Closing Merit? (Last Year Merit Explained)
pages.description: What closing merit means, why it drops from the 1st to the final merit list, and how to use last year's closing merit to judge your admission chances.
pages.h1: What Is Closing Merit and How to Use It
pages.answer: Closing merit is the aggregate of the last student admitted to a program or college in a merit list. For example, Narowal Medical College's open-merit MBBS seats closed at 93.51% in the final 2025 UHS list. Compare your aggregate with the last two years' final-list closing merits to judge your chances.

faq.q: Is closing merit the same as the merit list?
faq.a: No. The merit list is the list of admitted students; closing merit is one number from it, the lowest aggregate admitted for a program or college.

faq.q: Does closing merit go down in later lists?
faq.a: Usually yes, because seats left by students who move or leave are given to the next students in merit order.

faq.q: Will this year's closing merit be the same as last year?
faq.a: No. It changes with test difficulty, seats and applicants. Use the last two years as a guide, not a guarantee.

faq.q: Closing merit ka kya matlab hai?
faq.a: Kisi list mein jis aakhri student ka admission hua, us ka aggregate closing merit kehlata hai.

faq.q: Last year merit se kaise pata chale ga ke admission hoga?
faq.a: Apna aggregate pichle do saal ke final list, open merit closing merit se milayein. 1.5 points se zyada upar hon to chance strong hai, qareeb hon to borderline.

pages.roman_urdu:
Closing merit yani kisi college ya program mein aakhri admission kis aggregate par hua. Pehli list ke baad log college badalte hain, is liye final list ka merit aam tor par kam hota hai.

Misaal ke liye MDCAT merit list dekhein.

pages.title: UET Taxila Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (ECAT Formula)
pages.description: UET Taxila aggregate calculator {season_year}: 33% ECAT, 50% FSc Part-I, 17% Matric, with Hafiz marks. Compare your aggregate with last closing merits.
pages.subtitle: Official formula: 33% ECAT/TCAT + 50% FSc Part-I + 17% Matric
pages.answer: The UET Taxila aggregate for {season_year} = 33% entry test (ECAT or TCAT) + 50% FSc Part-I + 17% Matric, per the university's admission rules. Example from the UET Taxila prospectus: 300/400 test, 500/550 FSc Part-I plus 20 Hafiz marks and 700/1100 Matric give 82.84%. Enter your marks below.

faq.q: What is the UET Taxila aggregate formula for {season_year}?
faq.a: For BSc Engineering and BS Computer Science: 33% entry test (ECAT or TCAT), 50% FSc Part-I and 17% Matric. BS Mathematics and BS Physics use 70% FSc Part-I and 30% Matric.

faq.q: Is ECAT out of 400 for UET Taxila?
faq.a: UET Taxila's own calculator uses 400 as the entry test total. If your test has another total, change it in the calculator.

faq.q: Does UET Taxila add Hafiz-e-Quran marks?
faq.a: Yes. The prospectus adds 20 Hafiz-e-Quran marks (and NCC marks, where applicable) to FSc Part-I marks for merit only, not for eligibility.

faq.q: Why does UET Taxila use FSc Part-I marks?
faq.a: The merit lists are made before FSc Part-II results are out, so the formula uses first-year (Part-I) marks. DAE holders use their diploma marks instead.

faq.q: What aggregate is needed for Software Engineering at UET Taxila?
faq.a: Software Engineering closed at 79.435% on open merit for 2024 entry, the highest of all UET Taxila programs. Computer Science closed at 77.979%.

faq.q: What is the lowest closing merit at UET Taxila?
faq.a: For 2024 entry, Environmental Engineering closed lowest at 53.071% on open merit, followed by Industrial & Manufacturing at 53.781%.

faq.q: UET Taxila ka aggregate kaise nikalain?
faq.a: Entry test marks ko total se divide kar ke 33 se multiply karein, FSc Part-I ko total se divide kar ke 50 se aur Matric ko total se divide kar ke 17 se. Teeno ko jama kar lein.

faq.q: UET Taxila mein kitna aggregate chahiye?
faq.a: 2024 mein Software Engineering 79.435% par aur Computer Science 77.979% par close hui. Zyada tar engineering programs 58% se 66% ke darmiyan close hue.

pages.roman_urdu:
UET Taxila ka formula: entry test (ECAT/TCAT) 33%, FSc Part-I 50% aur Matric 17%. Hafiz-e-Quran ho to FSc mein 20 marks barh jate hain.

Misaal: test 300/400, FSc Part-I 500/550 (+20 Hafiz) aur Matric 700/1100 ho to aggregate 82.84% banta hai. Phir UET Taxila merit list se pichle saal ka closing merit milayein.

pages.title: UET Peshawar Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (ETEA Formula)
pages.description: UET Peshawar aggregate calculator {season_year}: 50% entrance test, 40% FSc Part-I and 10% Matric for BSc Engineering, plus the BS Computer Science formula.
pages.subtitle: Official formula: 50% entrance test + 40% FSc Part-I + 10% Matric
pages.answer: The UET Peshawar aggregate for BSc Engineering = 50% entrance test + 40% Intermediate Part-I (adjusted marks) + 10% SSC, per the UG Prospectus 2026-27. The test has 100 one-mark MCQs. Example: 70/100 test, 480/550 Part-I and 1000/1100 Matric give 79.00%. Enter your marks below.

faq.q: What is the UET Peshawar aggregate formula?
faq.a: For BSc Engineering: 50% entrance test, 40% Intermediate Part-I (adjusted marks) and 10% SSC, according to the UG Prospectus 2026-27.

faq.q: How many marks is the UET Peshawar entrance test?
faq.a: For 2026-27 the engineering paper has 100 MCQs, one mark each, with no negative marking. The pre-medical paper has 65 MCQs, and 65 marks count as 100%.

faq.q: What is the BS Computer Science formula at UET Peshawar?
faq.a: BS Computer Science has no entrance test: 40% SSC and 60% Intermediate Part-I (adjusted marks).

faq.q: What are adjusted marks?
faq.a: UET Peshawar deducts marks for papers passed in a later attempt (at most 20 marks) and 10 marks for Mathematics taken as an additional subject. Hafiz-e-Quran candidates who pass the university's test get 20 extra marks.

faq.q: Where can I see the UET Peshawar closing merit?
faq.a: UET Peshawar puts revised merit lists on its main campus notice board. We have not found an official program-wise closing merit online, so we do not show one yet.

faq.q: UET Peshawar ka aggregate kaise nikalta hai?
faq.a: Entrance test ka 50%, FSc Part-I ka 40% aur Matric ka 10%. Har marks ko total se divide karein, weight se multiply karein aur jama kar lein.

faq.q: Kya UET Peshawar ke test mein negative marking hai?
faq.a: Nahi. 2026-27 ke prospectus ke mutabiq har sahi jawab ka aik mark hai aur negative marking nahi hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
UET Peshawar BSc Engineering ka formula: entrance test 50%, FSc Part-I 40% aur Matric 10%. Test 100 MCQs ka hai, negative marking nahi.

Misaal: test 70/100, Part-I 480/550 aur Matric 1000/1100 ho to aggregate 79.00% banta hai. BS Computer Science mein test nahi: Matric 40% aur Part-I 60%.

sources.label: UET Peshawar UG Prospectus 2026-27: Admission Rules 5.3, 6.1, 6.3; BS programmes 6.1

pages.title: NED Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (Merit Score Formula)
pages.description: NED aggregate calculator {season_year}: merit score = 40% HSC Part-I + 60% NED entry test (out of 100). Enter your marks and get your NED merit score.
pages.subtitle: Official formula: 40% HSC Part-I + 60% NED entry test
pages.answer: NED University's merit score for {season_year} = 40% HSC Part-I (or O-level / equivalent) + 60% NED entry test, per its Admissions Schedule 2026. The test has four 25-mark sections (100). Example: 70/100 in the test and 480/550 in HSC Part-I give a merit score of 76.91%. Enter your marks below.

faq.q: What is the NED merit formula for {season_year}?
faq.a: Merit Score = 40% HSC Part-I (or O-level / equivalent) marks + 60% NED entry test marks, as set in the Admissions Schedule 2026.

faq.q: Are Matric marks counted at NED?
faq.a: No. For HSC candidates the NED merit score uses only HSC Part-I and the entry test.

faq.q: How many marks is the NED entry test?
faq.a: The pre-admission test is computer based with four sections of 25 marks each, so 100 in total. You need at least 50% to qualify.

faq.q: Can I take the NED entry test twice?
faq.a: Yes. NED holds the test twice and counts the higher of your two scores.

faq.q: Does NED publish a closing percentage?
faq.a: No. NED publishes provisional call lists in order of merit, not a closing percentage per discipline.

faq.q: NED ka merit kaise banta hai?
faq.a: NED entry test ka 60% aur HSC Part-I ka 40%. Matric ke marks shamil nahi hote.

faq.q: NED test mein pass hone ke liye kitne marks chahiye?
faq.a: Test mein kam az kam 50% marks chahiye, yani 100 mein se 50.

pages.roman_urdu:
NED ka merit score: entry test 60% aur HSC Part-I 40%. Matric ke marks is mein nahi aate. Test 100 marks ka hai aur pass hone ke liye 50% chahiye.

Misaal: test 70/100 aur HSC Part-I 480/550 ho to merit score 76.91% banta hai.

NED Undergraduate Admissions FAQ 2026 (merit criteria, entry test)

pages.title: FAST Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (Computing & Engineering)
pages.description: FAST aggregate calculator {season_year}: computing 50% test, 40% FSc, 10% Matric; engineering 33% test, 50% FSc, 17% Matric, from FAST-NUCES eligibility rules.
pages.subtitle: Computing: 50% test + 40% FSc + 10% Matric · Engineering: 33% + 50% + 17%
pages.answer: The FAST-NUCES aggregate for BS Computing = 50% admission test + 40% FSc (HSSC) + 10% Matric; for BS Engineering it is 33% test + 50% FSc + 17% Matric, per FAST's eligibility criteria. Example: 60% test, 950/1100 FSc and 1000/1100 Matric give 73.64% for computing. Enter your marks below.

faq.q: What is the FAST aggregate formula for computing programs?
faq.a: BS Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Cyber Security and Software Engineering use 50% admission test, 40% HSSC and 10% SSC.

faq.q: What is the FAST formula for engineering?
faq.a: BS Civil, Electrical and Computer Engineering use 33% admission test, 50% HSSC and 17% SSC.

faq.q: Which test does FAST accept?
faq.a: FAST's own admission test or NTS NAT (NAT-IE for engineering; NAT-IE or NAT-ICS for computing). Test results from other universities are not accepted.

faq.q: Which FSc marks does FAST use?
faq.a: HSSC Part I and II marks, or Part I alone if Part II is not available when the merit list is compiled. A-level students use their IBCC equivalence.

faq.q: What is the FAST closing merit?
faq.a: FAST does not publish program-wise closing merits; the university determines merit cut-offs each year. Figures on other websites are estimates.

faq.q: FAST ka aggregate kaise nikalain?
faq.a: Computing ke liye test ka 50%, FSc ka 40% aur Matric ka 10% jama karein. Engineering ke liye test 33%, FSc 50% aur Matric 17%.

faq.q: FAST mein admission ke liye kitne FSc marks chahiye?
faq.a: Engineering ke liye Matric aur FSc dono mein 60%, computing ke liye Matric mein 60% aur FSc mein 50%.

pages.roman_urdu:
FAST ke do formule hain: computing (CS, AI, SE waghera) mein test 50%, FSc 40%, Matric 10%, aur engineering mein test 33%, FSc 50%, Matric 17%.

Misaal: test 60%, FSc 950/1100 aur Matric 1000/1100 ho to computing aggregate 73.64% aur engineering aggregate 78.44% banta hai.

sources.label: FAST-NUCES: Eligibility Criteria, undergraduate selection criteria
FAST-NUCES Prospectus 2026: Admission Information

pages.title: GIKI Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (85% Test Formula)
pages.description: GIKI aggregate calculator {season_year}: 85% GIKI admission test + 15% Matric (SSC), from GIKI's official assessment criteria. See your merit score now.
pages.subtitle: Official formula: 85% admission test + 15% Matric
pages.answer: The GIKI aggregate for {season_year} = 85% GIKI admission test + 15% SSC (Matric) or equivalent, per GIKI's Comparative Assessment Criteria. FSc marks only decide eligibility. Example: 70% in the test and 1000/1100 in Matric give 73.14%. Enter your marks below.

faq.q: What is the GIKI aggregate formula?
faq.a: GIKI ranks applicants by 85% admission test score and 15% SSC (Matric) or equivalent.

faq.q: Are FSc marks counted in GIKI merit?
faq.a: No. FSc marks are only for eligibility: 60% or more each in Mathematics, Physics and overall for engineering and computing programs.

faq.q: What do A-level students use for the 15% part?
faq.a: Their O-level result converted by IBCC equivalence. Diploma, IB or DAE holders use their last completed qualification.

faq.q: How much does one test mark matter at GIKI?
faq.a: Each percentage point in the test adds 0.85 to your aggregate, so the test decides almost all of your merit.

faq.q: Does GIKI publish a closing merit?
faq.a: We have not found an official program-wise closing aggregate from GIKI, so we do not show one.

faq.q: GIKI ka merit kaise banta hai?
faq.a: Admission test ka 85% aur Matric ka 15%. FSc ke marks sirf eligibility ke liye hain.

faq.q: GIKI ke liye FSc mein kitne marks chahiye?
faq.a: Engineering aur computing ke liye Math, Physics aur overall teeno mein 60% ya zyada.

pages.roman_urdu:
GIKI ka formula seedha hai: admission test 85% aur Matric 15%. FSc ke marks merit mein nahi aate, sirf eligibility (60%) ke liye dekhe jate hain.

Misaal: test 70% aur Matric 1000/1100 ho to aggregate 73.14% banta hai. Is liye GIKI mein sab se zyada farq test se padta hai.

pages.h1: UET Taxila Merit List {season_year} & Closing Merit by Program
pages.subtitle: Open merit, last admitted aggregate per department (2024 entry, official prospectus)
pages.answer: UET Taxila's latest official closing merits (open merit, 2024 entry) run from 79.435% for Software Engineering and 77.979% for Computer Science down to 53.071% for Environmental Engineering. Most engineering programs closed between 58% and 66%. Source: UET Taxila UG Prospectus 2025, Merit Position Entry 2024.

faq.q: What was the UET Taxila closing merit for Software Engineering?
faq.a: 79.435% on open merit for 2024 entry, the highest at UET Taxila.

faq.q: What was the UET Taxila Computer Science closing merit?
faq.a: BS Computer Science closed at 77.979% and the pre-medical Computer Science seats at 78.184% for 2024 entry.

faq.q: Which UET Taxila program has the lowest merit?
faq.a: Environmental Engineering at 53.071%, then Industrial & Manufacturing Engineering at 53.781% (open merit, 2024 entry).

faq.q: Why is there no {data_year} closing merit for UET Taxila?
faq.a: UET Taxila publishes its program-wise closing table in the next year's prospectus. The latest one on its site is 'Merit Position Entry – 2024' in the 2025 prospectus. We will add newer figures when an official document has them.

faq.q: Where is the official UET Taxila merit list?
faq.a: Merit lists are posted on admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk during admissions, and the closing table is in the UG prospectus. Every row here links to the prospectus.

faq.q: UET Taxila ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: 2024 mein Software Engineering 79.435%, Computer Science 77.979% aur Civil 65.519% par close hui. Environmental sab se kam 53.071% par.

faq.q: UET Taxila mein Electrical Engineering ka merit kya tha?
faq.a: 2024 mein Electrical Engineering open merit par 58.063% par close hui.

pages.roman_urdu:
Yeh UET Taxila ka official closing merit hai, yani har department mein open merit par aakhri admission kis aggregate par hua (2024 entry, prospectus 2025 ka table).

Software Engineering 79.435% par sab se upar, Computer Science 77.979% aur zyada tar engineering programs 58% se 66% ke darmiyan. Apna aggregate UET Taxila aggregate calculator se nikalein.

pages.title: 1st, 2nd and Final Merit List: How Much Does Merit Drop?
pages.description: 1st vs 2nd vs final merit list explained with real UHS 2025 figures: public MBBS dropped 0.08 points on average, private MBBS 9 points. Know which to use.
pages.answer: The 1st merit list offers seats to the top applicants; the 2nd and later lists fill seats that students leave, so the closing aggregate falls with each list. How much depends on demand: in UHS Punjab's 2025 lists, public MBBS fell only 0.08 points on average from the 1st to the final list, private MBBS about 9 points.

faq.q: How much does merit drop in the 2nd merit list?
faq.a: It depends on the program. For Punjab public MBBS in 2025 the drop from 1st to final list was under 0.15 points per college, but private MBBS colleges dropped about 9 points on average.

faq.q: Is the final merit list lower than the 1st list?
faq.a: Almost always, because each later list fills seats left by students who moved or declined, reaching further down the merit order.

faq.q: Which merit list should I compare my aggregate with?
faq.a: Last year's final list, because it shows the lowest aggregate that still got a seat. Compare with the 1st list too to see how safe you are.

faq.q: Can I get admission in the 2nd merit list if not in the 1st?
faq.a: Yes. Many students are admitted in later lists, especially in programs and private colleges where many top applicants leave.

faq.q: What is an upgrade in a merit list?
faq.a: An admitted student is moved to a higher-choice program or college when a seat opens there. UHS lists show this in an 'Upgraded To' column.

faq.q: 2nd merit list mein merit kitna girta hai?
faq.a: Har program mein alag. 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka merit 1st se final list tak sirf 0.04 se 0.13 gira, lekin private MBBS ka average 9 points.

faq.q: Pehli list mein naam na aaye to kya karein?
faq.a: Agli lists ka intezar karein aur har list ki deadline par nazar rakhein. Seat khali hone par agle students ko mauqa milta hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
Pehli merit list mein top students ko seat milti hai. Jo students chhor dete hain ya dusri jagah chale jate hain, un ki seats 2nd aur agli lists mein agle students ko milti hain, is liye merit har list ke saath neeche aata hai.

2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS ka merit 1st se final list tak sirf 0.08 gira, lekin private MBBS ka taqreeban 9 points. Apna aggregate hamesha pichle saal ki final list se milayein, jaise MDCAT merit list par.
